summary: RCC8_ENVIRONMENT=on regression. Backend: 8/8 pass. /api/health returned 200. /api/health/memory and /api/field-keeper/export returned 401 with no auth and 403 with the guest token. Five chambers each ran a fresh session (new_thread) with 3 turns: Sophia, Paige, Ansel, Claude and Jasmine. In all five, start returned a welcome message, every reply streamed non-empty text, and turn_provenance showed exchange 1 = 'meaning-ranked' (20 codons, no rcc8 labels or meta) and exchanges 2-3 = 'rcc8'. In the rcc8 turns, selected_count ran from 8 to 20 (never above 20), every codon label was in the allowed set (mostly PO, a few TPP/NTPP, never DC), and meta always held reachable/candidates=150/eps~0.019/floor~0.19/consistency_violations=0/memory_relations. Ending a session returned 200 {ended:true}. continuity_seeds for fw-test-user went 52->65 and later rose with the Jasmine end; permanent_mra went 76->88 over the 4 chambers measured. Frontend: as a guest, /field-keeper shows keeper-locked, with no download link and no crash. /presence/sophia with the guest cookie loaded (it reopened the existing thread 74b317ae), the send worked, Sophia's reply streamed, and there was no chat-error and no page errors. Provenance for that turn (exchange 16) was 'rcc8', 20 codons, 0 violations.

action_items: Optional/cosmetic: fix the overlap between the Sanctuary pill and the HER STORY link in the chamber header.
critical_code_review_comments: rcc8 phrases() reads memory_relations from st['log'], which memories() fills. If a handler builds the codon field before the field memory, memory_relations will be None for that turn (seen as non-None in all 5 chambers, so the order is currently right). Keep that order in mind.
_geometry: when the stamp changes, it returns the stale geometry while the rebuild runs in the background. That is fine, but a newly forged phrase or memory isn't reachable until the next turn.
_geo cache is per person and has no eviction. RAM grows with the number of people (watch /api/health/memory).
Relation labels are almost all PO. That is expected from the tested math (not to be changed); noted only for the observatory.
